The intro reader predicted every roadmap section in order (incident, concepts, public contracts, architecture with keys/guard/reconciliation/errors/back-pressure/insertion flow, Golf and Hearthly, trade-offs, verticals, failure modes, CA view, questions) and the evidence mix of fictional Veldmark plus published partner contracts.

Reader gives the per-seller guard with size-scaled thresholds, held runs reported and confirmed or superseded, the surviving key mapping, absence semantics, a numeric removal SLA via status deltas within 15 minutes, stable-code run reports and weekly reconciliation against live external keys. Omits field ownership and the single idempotent command keyed by the partner reference, both peripheral to this probe's scenario; the core of the expected answer is present.
Reader answers all three parts as expected: mapping as listing data surviving removal, the three keys with scope and purpose, and the 26-hour SLA by construction with the hybrid-contract fix.
